DM-WARFARIN-3.title: WARFARIN SODIUM tablet — REMEDYREPACK INC.
DM-WARFARIN-3.quote: Because bleeding risk is increased when these drugs are used concomitantly with warfarin, closely monitor patients receiving any such drug with warfarin.

records.finding: The label lists aspirin among medicines associated with increased bleeding risk when used with warfarin.
The label lists ibuprofen among medicines associated with increased bleeding risk when used with warfarin.
